key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws from data, targeting the objectives behind observed behavior rather than only input–output equations.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable optimization principles from observed system behavior.
method: Learn to represent observed data as an optimization problem.
Extract a compact symbolic form of the inferred optimization problem.
Use an LLM agent to integrate literature priors, interpret mechanisms, and suggest new data collection.
evidence_signal: On OptFeynman's 99 physics-derived problems, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; on risky choice and monetary policy, it achieves competitive held-out prediction with few parameters.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that an inferred objective is the true underlying mechanism.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
